subject: effort-switch-focus
kind: repair
result: pass
revision: 9da847f
evidence: Before the fix, `uv run --with textual --with pytest python -m pytest tests/test_dashboard_app.py -q -k switch` gave 1 failed, 1 passed. The new test failed with active == 'effort-beta' when it expected 'effort-alpha'. After the fix, the same command gave 2 passed. The full suite `uv run -q --with textual --with pytest --with pytest-xdist python -m pytest tests/test_dashboard_app.py -q -n 4` gave 165 passed. The tmux tests `uv run -q --with textual --with pytest python -m pytest tests -q -m tmux -rf` (serial) gave 10 passed, 333 deselected. A scratch pilot test, not committed, covered three more cases: the live table hidden by the empty Done status tab with NeedsList focused (tab and shift+tab), and the slash filter followed by n and tab. It failed before the fix and passed after it.
observations: The bounce reproduces in both directions. With the beta continuity question present, tab and shift+tab from beta to the finished alpha both snap back to beta. The same bounce happens when beta's own table is hidden by an empty status tab and NeedsList has focus. After the fix, switching back to a live effort still focuses its TaskTable, because on_tabbed_content_tab_activated calls focus_tasks. On a pane with no visible table, focus stays None. That matches the old behaviour when an effort had no Needs you items. The new test is test_tab_and_shift_tab_switch_to_a_finished_effort_beside_live_needs_you_items in tests/test_dashboard_app.py. The fix is one line in step_effort in scripts/dashboard_app.py: `tabs.screen.set_focus(None)` runs before `tabs.active` changes. The dashboard does not write to the store.
root_cause: step_effort switched TabbedContent.active while focus stayed on a widget in the old pane. When the old pane hid, Screen._reset_focus moved focus to the next focusable sibling in that hidden pane, the NeedsList. TabbedContent then re-activated the pane that held the focused widget. The new pane had no focused widget to hold the switch. The fix clears focus before the switch, so no widget in the old pane can claim focus.
verdict: pass
